description: Read a private mail cache and subscribe queues or agents to new mail
author: Serg Parf

limit.help: Maximum items, 1..100; defaults are stated per method

uid.help: Mailbox UID, 1..4294967295, never an IMAP command or sequence number

target.help: A queue or agent whose ACL admits this IMAP instance; the author must also be admitted

id.help: Subscription id returned by sub add

sync.help: Fetch uncached history newest first; default 100; return descending history and more flag. A forwarding-state error blocks sync until rebaseline; read/list/search remain available.

list.help: Return decoded Date/From/Subject, newest UID first; default 20 rows. Date is as sent, unverified; repeated fields show (multiple).

search.help: Return up to 100 decoded Date/From/Subject summaries matching local raw-mail text; no server criteria

args.name: text
args.help: Nonempty local case-insensitive text, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes; no controls

read.help: Return one raw message with an external-content warning and cache status; re-check existence

publish.help: Send one external-content warning and raw mail to Configuration target; explicit repeats copy again

sub add.help: Subscribe to mail arriving after this add, never the old backlog. Missing or empty filter matches ALL mail from this account. Author may-send is checked at add and each forward; the receiver must also admit this IMAP instance. At most 20 subscriptions per creator, 100 total.

args.name: filter
args.help: Match sender addr-spec plus decoded subject; common regex subset, at most 200 characters, optional /imsu flags; no g/y

sub list.help: List every subscription for every admitted caller, including creator, held count and UID range, pause, intake state, skipped counts/reasons/ranges and repair status. No mailbox connection. A blank line separates the final cached poll-status line.

sub delete.help: Creator or this IMAP Owner/Maintainers may delete; held copies are discarded. Delete+add starts at current UIDNEXT and skips mail received while paused.

status.help: Return the last poll view and its age, pause/held/backlog/loss/repair counts; no mailbox connection.

mode.help: Implicit verified TLS by default; plain requires explicit loopback opt-out

auth.help: App password (default) or Google XOAUTH2; no fallback

mailbox.help: Mailbox or Gmail label, Unicode accepted; default INBOX

target.help: Optional fixed publication destination; required only for publish

cache_bytes.help: Logical cache byte budget including state/temporary writes; default 67108864, range 4194304..536870912

cafile.help: Optional existing public CA trust file visible inside the sandbox

allow_plaintext.help: Explicit opt-out permitting plain mode only to loopback; default false
